	if = { limit = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_esotericism } value = 1 }
}
kehillah_lib_mastery_chance_work_hekhalot_rabbati = {
	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_base desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_BASE }
	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_learning_term desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LEARNING format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_fluency_work_hekhalot_rabbati = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_israelite } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_israelite > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_israelite > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 100 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_hekhalot_rabbati = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_hekhalot_rabbati = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_hekhalot_rabbati } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_reread desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_REREAD format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_study_torah_mastery_bonus }
		add = { value = 100 desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_GUIDED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min
}

	if = { limit = { knows_language = language_aramaic } add = 1 }
}
kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_baalei_hamiqra } value = 1 }
}
kehillah_lib_mastery_chance_work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot = {
	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_base desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_BASE }
	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_learning_term desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LEARNING format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_fluency_work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_aramaic } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_aramaic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_aramaic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = talmudics value >= 100 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_TALMUDICS format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = talmudics value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_TALMUDICS format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_reread desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_REREAD format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_study_torah_mastery_bonus }
		add = { value = 100 desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_GUIDED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min
}
